quote.text: In every walk with nature, one receives far more than he seeks.
quote.author: John Muir

fun_fact.text: In Hungary, September 13th marks the beginning of grape harvest season in many wine regions. Families traditionally celebrate with music, dancing, and of course, sampling the new wine. The harvest festival, called 'szüret,' has been a beloved Hungarian tradition for centuries.

short_read.title: The Secret Social Lives of Hummingbirds
short_read.teaser: Scientists have discovered that hummingbirds are far more social than previously thought, with complex relationships and even friendships. These tiny birds remember individual humans and other hummingbirds for years.

medium_read.title: The Fascinating Story of Ellis Island's Forgotten Immigrant Hospital
medium_read.teaser: Before immigrants could enter America, many passed through a massive hospital complex on Ellis Island that treated over a million people. The abandoned buildings still stand today, filled with the echoes of countless journeys to a new life.

long_read.title: Hungary's Hidden Gardens: The Tradition of Kitchen Gardens
long_read.teaser: From Budapest to the countryside, Hungarians have maintained beautiful kitchen gardens for generations, growing everything from paprika to medicinal herbs. This rich tradition connects modern families to their ancestors and the land.

port_angeles.title: Roosevelt Elk Gathering Season
port_angeles.description: September is prime time to see Roosevelt elk gathering in meadows throughout Olympic National Park. Early morning and evening are the best times to spot these majestic animals near Hurricane Ridge and the Hoh Rain Forest. The bulls are especially impressive this time of year with their large antlers.

puzzle_1.question: A hummingbird's heart beats approximately ___ times per minute while in flight.
puzzle_1.correct_response: Amazing! You're absolutely right — 1,200 beats per minute! That tiny heart works incredibly hard.
puzzle_1.close_response: You're very close! A hummingbird's heart beats about 1,200 times per minute in flight — that's incredibly fast!
puzzle_1.wrong_response: A hummingbird's heart actually beats about 1,200 times per minute! That's roughly 20 beats every single second — amazing!
puzzle_1.learn_more_text: To power their incredible hovering flight, hummingbirds have the fastest metabolism of any animal on Earth. At night, they enter a hibernation-like state called torpor to conserve energy.

puzzle_2.question: Which Hungarian word means 'butterfly'?
puzzle_2.correct_response: Wonderful! Pillangó is indeed butterfly! It's such a lovely, flowing word, just like the creature itself.
puzzle_2.wrong_response: The word is 'pillangó' — doesn't it sound beautiful? (Madár means bird, virág means flower, and méhecske means little bee!)
puzzle_2.learn_more_text: Hungarian is a unique language unrelated to most European languages. It's part of the Finno-Ugric family and has a wonderfully poetic quality, especially in words for nature.

puzzle_3.question: What is the Strait of Juan de Fuca named after?
options: A Greek explorer who sailed for Spain
puzzle_3.correct_response: Exactly right! He was a Greek navigator named Ioannis Phokas who sailed under the Spanish flag in 1592. His name was Hispanicized to Juan de Fuca, and he claimed to have found this passage to the Pacific!
puzzle_3.wrong_response: It was actually named after a Greek explorer, Ioannis Phokas, who sailed for Spain! His name was Hispanicized to Juan de Fuca when he explored these waters in 1592.
puzzle_3.learn_more_text: Juan de Fuca's voyage and the strait he described were controversial for centuries, with some doubting his claims. The strait is a vital waterway connecting the Pacific Ocean to Puget Sound and the Salish Sea.
